title: Evidence summary and next interpretation
subtitle: Cytotoxic module results, GO support and sensitivity are reported separately.
reference: Huang et al. 2024, PAGER-scFGA, Fig. 5; doi:10.3389/fbinf.2024.1336135; Borra et al. 2026, GAFA, Sec. 3.5 / Fig. 4c; doi:10.3390/biology15070588

notes_zh: 总结按表达差异绝对值排序。优先看基因组成、QC匹配、背景校正评分是否同向，再讨论GO机制；不要把转录结果写成已验证杀伤增强或减弱。
